headline: Playable loop verified 37/37. Render pipeline repaired. Boss presence, lighting values and composition are the open failures.
playable: title -> combat -> 3 boss phases -> stagger -> death -> restart -> victory -> ending

perf.note: Headless Chromium uses a software rasteriser — these are a FLOOR, not desktop-GPU numbers. 1079 draw calls is hardware-independent and too high; instancing is queued for wave 2.

workstreams.name: Boss presence & animation
workstreams.note: The deity is absent from the hero and gameplay framings — the single biggest failure.

workstreams.name: Lighting & value structure
workstreams.note: Far field is near-white; target is mid-grey fog over dark water. Moon not visible.

workstreams.name: Water
workstreams.note: Reflection works; too mirror-bright, ripples not reading.

workstreams.name: Environment composition
workstreams.note: Posts read as random scatter; frame edges not reliably occupied.

workstreams.name: Player design & animation
workstreams.note: Reads as a dark blob at gameplay distance.

workstreams.name: Post-processing & fog
workstreams.note: DOF repaired; grade is washing values out.

workstreams.name: Camera & composition
workstreams.note: Player centred rather than low-left; boss never framed.

weaknesses: The boss does not appear in the hero or gameplay camera at all — the centrepiece is invisible.
Value structure is inverted: fog reads near-white, water reads bright, nothing is dark.
The moon is not visible in frame despite being the key light and the compositional crown.
Environment placement reads as procedural scatter, not authored composition.
Player silhouette is an unlit blob at gameplay distance.
1079 draw calls for a scene this size.
passes: Baseline vertical slice — full playable loop, 37/37 smoke checks.
Render pipeline repair — colour space, layer masking, DOF depth feedback loop, ShaderPass texture binding, fog card density, telegraph decal blowout.

shots.desc: reference framing — boss absent, values washed out
